x: With sprinter David Rees, John and Bob Hamilton over the 'half' and 'quarter' and new members Michael and Trevor Day and John Crockford over the longer distances, we have the makings of a first class Youth team.
The Hamilton twins reached the finals of the Junior 440 and 880, John doing a personal best 53.5 in the quarter and Bob 2:06.3 in the half, just ahead of T.
Trevor Day 31:30 A very good 5 miles with going heavy in places.

As it was, we beat Walton on the day but with Mitcham easy winners we had to settle for a final league placing of third. With our leading runners racing elsewhere T. Day, Carton and Langley stepped into the breach admirably.
